issues.label: Depression
issues.what: More than feeling sad: a persistently low mood, loss of interest and drained energy that lasts for weeks and can colour everything.
issues.help: NICE recommends talking therapies such as CBT and behavioural activation. Speaking to someone early can make a real difference.

issues.label: Anxiety
issues.what: Worry or fear that feels out of proportion and hard to switch off, often with a racing heart, tension or poor sleep.
issues.help: CBT, which NICE recommends for anxiety, helps you understand and loosen the cycle of worry and avoidance.

issues.label: Trauma & PTSD
issues.what: After a frightening or distressing event, memories can return as flashbacks or nightmares, or leave you feeling constantly on edge.
issues.help: NICE recommends trauma-focused CBT and EMDR. Our psychologists are trained in EMDR.

issues.label: OCD
issues.what: Unwanted, intrusive thoughts, and the urges, checks or rituals used to try to make the anxiety go away.
issues.help: NICE recommends CBT that includes exposure and response prevention (ERP).

issues.label: ADHD
issues.what: Lifelong differences in attention, focus, restlessness and organisation that are often missed until adulthood.
issues.help: A thorough adult ADHD assessment can bring clarity, followed by practical strategies that suit how your mind works.

issues.label: Stress & burnout
issues.what: When demands outweigh your resources for too long: exhaustion, irritability and feeling detached from work or life.
issues.help: Together we look at the pressures, boundaries and patterns that keep you running on empty, and how to recover.

issues.label: Grief & loss
issues.what: A natural response to losing someone or something important, but it can become stuck, overwhelming or isolating.
issues.help: A safe space to make sense of the loss and find a way to carry it as you go on living.

issues.label: Sleep problems
issues.what: Trouble falling or staying asleep that leaves your days foggy and everything harder to cope with.
issues.help: Structured CBT-based approaches for insomnia (CBT-I) are recommended in NICE guidance.

issues.label: Low self-esteem
issues.what: A harsh inner critic and a deep, persistent sense of not being good enough.
issues.help: Approaches such as CBT and schema therapy help you notice and question long-held beliefs about yourself.

issues.label: Phobias
issues.what: An intense fear of a specific thing or situation, strong enough that you go out of your way to avoid it.
issues.help: Gradual, supported exposure, at a pace you agree with your psychologist, is a well-established approach.
